jointProposal.status: DEVELOPMENT PROPOSAL ONLY; freeze before reading heldout outcomes
jointProposal.selection_pool: Exactly the nine preselected layout×routing combinations; default-routing references benchmark them but cannot be substituted into this selected set.
jointProposal.selection_rule: Exhaustive equal-budget subsets; maximize hard-valid case union, then acceptable case×profile coverage, then minimize equal-family mean regret on valid covered jobs, then lexical IDs. Frozen scores and practical bands use the full 12-combination comparison universe (3 default-routing references + 9 joint alternatives).
jointProposal.deployment_distinction: The fixed global choice can be deployed without an oracle. The three- and nine-combination results are per-job choice upper bounds for Compare, not automatic selection. No new input-feature router selector is fitted here.
jointProposal.guard: Report raw direct hard-valid losses against current; any hard-validity fallback must be separately labeled and its cost included. No soft-quality fallback or heldout retuning is authorized by this proposal.
jointProposal.compiler_coupling_limit: Routing options are applied after actual source compilation. This evaluates source-produced positions plus production routing, not changing compiler spacing with router settings.

visualBandDecision.reason: Thirty-six blinded development pairs expose both useful ties and metric/visual reversals. Keep the declared bands for reproducibility, explicitly retain visual disagreements, and do not claim human-calibrated perceptual equivalence. No heldout outcomes exist.

heldoutRoutingPlan.rule: Apply three already selected routing settings to each current heldout source and all nine development-selected layout×routing combinations; preserve specialist source where generic root rebuild is inapplicable. Global/triple choices come only from jointProposal.

heldoutVisualPlan.rule: Twelve family strata plus twelve targeted completed-output comparisons: contested engine witnesses, worst frozen-portfolio regressions and metric/directness disagreements. Timeouts remain numeric failures and are never fabricated into full render pairs.

editWorkflow: Cold current/best-single/feature-selector; warm protected tidy/separate/group-aware. Global direction/fit dispatches to cold source rebuild; raw bounded-pass global reflow remains diagnostic. Color edits retain warm geometry.
supplementaryAudits: Direction/fit interpretation and cell-access raw-body obstacle audit are separately reported; frozen metrics/rankings are not silently rewritten.
decisionRule: Apply only stored development subsets/configurations/trees on heldout, report exact relative and absolute denominators plus hard regressions and specialist reachability. Do not train or select new configurations on heldout. A reduced automatic default requires the original95%relative contract; otherwise retain current behavior and document the smallest defensible accessible portfolio.
